content.text: If you're a digital creator in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, or any other country where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, or Paddle are unavailable or severely restricted, you're likely facing a daunting infrastructure problem: how to sell digital products without these platforms. With Stripe operating in only 46 countries out of 195, and a PayPal account suspension potentially holding funds for up to 180 days, the risks and limitations are clear.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital products

While Stripe and PayPal dominate the market, they're not the only options for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-courses-without-teachable-stripe-what-actually-how-3|Selling Courses]]-digital-downloads-pakistan-step-step-deployment-guide|selling]] digital products. Gumroad, for instance, allows creators to sell ebooks, courses, and other digital goods directly to customers, but it's not available in all countries. Lemon Squeezy, another popular choice, offers a more comprehensive suite of tools, but its restrictions are just as limiting. Meanwhile, NOWPayments, a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-4|COREMERCH guide to crypto]]currency payment processor, provides a unique opportunity for creators to receive payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies without relying on traditional payment gateways.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

When it comes to handling restricted countries, each option has its own set of rules and limitations. Stripe, for example, has a clear list of supported countries, while PayPal's restrictions are often ambiguous and subject to change. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy, on the other hand, have more restrictive policies, with some countries entirely off-limits. NOWPayments, however, offers a more open approach, allowing creators to receive payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, regardless of the country of origin.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed, fees, and real costs, the options vary significantly. Stripe and PayPal charge competitive transaction fees, but their payment processing times can be slow, especially for international transactions. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy, on the other hand, offer faster payment processing, but their fees can be higher. NOWPayments, meanwhile, offers instant payment processing, with fees as low as 0.5% for cryptocurrency transactions.
Selling digital products without Stripe or PayPal requires a sovereign commerce infrastructure.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When it comes to ownership, automation, and delivery, the options differ in their approach. Stripe and PayPal require creators to surrender control over their payment processing and customer data, while Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy offer more flexibility, but still rely on third-party infrastructure. NOWPayments, on the other hand, provides a full suite of automation tools, allowing creators to manage their digital product sales and deliveries entirely on their own terms.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Ultimately, the choice of architecture depends on your specific needs and circumstances. If you're looking for a straightforward, no-frills solution, Edge Commerce Stack ($197) might be the perfect fit, offering a pre-configured suite of tools for selling digital products, including Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. Alternatively, if you're looking for a more customized solution, NOWPayments' API and developer documentation provide a wealth of options for integrating their payment processing into your own infrastructure.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
NowPayments offers the most flexible and open approach for selling digital products in restricted countries.

With our pre-configured stacks and customization options, you can build a sovereign commerce infrastructure that meets your unique needs and circumstances.
Your Deployment Checklist

To get started with a sovereign commerce infrastructure, follow these concrete deployment steps: deploy Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages as your hosting platform; set up Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script as your backend logic; integrate NOWPayments as your payment processor; configure Supabase or Google Sheets as your order storage solution; and finally, deliver your digital products using Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive.
Frequently Asked Questions
What are the restrictions on using Stripe and PayPal in my country?

Stripe operates in only 46 countries out of 195, while PayPal's restrictions are often ambiguous and subject to change. If you're in a country where Stripe or PayPal are unavailable or severely restricted, you may need to explore alternative options like Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, or NOWPayments.
Can I use Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy if I'm in a restricted country?

While Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy offer more flexible policies than Stripe and PayPal, they still have their own set of restrictions. If you're in a country where Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy are unavailable, you may need to explore alternative options like NOWPayments or Edge Commerce Stack ($197).
Can I customize my NOWPayments integration?
YES, you can customize your NOWPayments integration using their API and developer documentation.
